title: The anatomy of a lead (vertical)
intent: Vertical social cutdown of the 16:9 lead film. Rebuilt in the vertical safe area, not cropped: new crop, new column layout, four chips instead of a horizontal chain, and the caption replaced by a kraft note chip sitting in the break itself. Drafted for internal review. Not published, not scheduled, not uploaded.

plateSource.provenance: Supplied by Dillon 2026-09-09 as visual direction. Licence NOT verified. Confirm before any use outside Momentum.

fillPlates._use: cream and kraft chip stock, caption card stock

palette._source: sampled from the five reference plates; see STYLE-CONTRACT.md section 1

factCheck._rule: Every on-screen word is either pattern-level with no number attached, or sourced below. No client, competitor or vendor is named on screen.
factCheck.chain click -> landing page -> form -> n: 12_Brain/03_Concepts/2026-09-07 - Conversion match-back is the differentiator.md — the path a lead payload has to survive 'from form to inbox to report'.
factCheck.the break at the notification: Same note: 'The Zapier notifications that arrive in Gmail carry no lead data. They carry a link... There is nothing in the message to reconcile against a platform conversion.'
factCheck.the kraft thread onward to the CRM: Same note — the conversion is still counted downstream, it just has no name against it. Depicted as a neutral kraft thread, not the indigo identity thread.
Same note: '...precisely what the defect above breaks, and precisely what most agencies never notice is broken.' Pattern-level positioning claim, no statistic attached.
factCheck._notShown: Same as the 16:9 cut. In addition the vertical drops the statement card entirely; the kraft note chip in the gap carries the meaning.
factCheck.Identity stops here: 12_Brain/03_Concepts/2026-09-07 - Conversion match-back is the differentiator.md — the lead payload does not survive the trip from form to inbox, so there is nothing left to reconcile. Pattern-level, no number attached.

accent.what: the frayed end of the indigo thread, screen (540,806)

beats._cropNote: 2.25x upscale on blank handmade paper. A 1080x1920 frame can show at most 529 plate px of width, so this is the floor for a full-bleed vertical from a 1672x941 plate. Blank paper is low-frequency and absorbs it; a beat cropped onto engraving would not.

links._what: indigo identity thread: click -> form. Real photographed indigo paper, cropped to a strip.
the break, first fibre: the thread leaves the form and stops in mid-air.
the break, last fibre. Nothing crosses the 144px gap to Notification, because the identity does not. The kraft note sits beside the gap, never in it — the empty column is the point.
kraft, not indigo: the record still reaches the CRM. It just has no name on it.

accent.what: where the Momentum mark lands, screen (540,872) — 146px below the frayed end, same column

beats._cropNote: Same page as b1, diagram lifted off.

card._what: Unused in this cut: no beat carries a statement line. Kept so the renderer has valid card stock.

endcard.markProvenance: clients/momentum-360/deliverables/2026-08-01-snow-logo-video/assets/momentum-360-logo-approved-circle.png — approved circle display derivative of the authoritative corporate mark (sha256 94D1059C...), per that deliverable's brand-provenance.md. Used unmodified.
endcard.name: Momentum 360
